name: 💪 영어회화 | 표현정리 - 처음에는, 애초에, 먼저, ~하는게 처음이다

keywords.en: First
at first
At first it was a little awkward. It was a little awkward at first
I wasn’t very interested at first. At first, I wasn’t very interested
At first it was a little hard(difficult) but it was OK once(after) I got used to it.
keywords.ko: 처음에는 좀 어려웠는데 익숙해지고 나니까 괜찮았어.

keywords.en: in the first place/ to begin with
bold_words: in the first place/ to begin with

I shouldn’t have brought it up in the first place
keywords.ko: 내가  애초에 말을 꺼내지 말았어야 했어.

my_sentences.en: at first
my_sentences.ko: (처음에는)→ at first는 항상 '하지만 나중에는 달라졌다(but later...)'라는 반전의 의미를 내포하고 있습니다. 처음 상태와 현재(또는 나중) 상태를 대비시킬 때 사용합니다.

my_sentences.en: At first, I didn't like the taste of coffee.
my_sentences.ko: (처음에는 커피 맛을 안 좋아했어. - 지금은 좋아함)

my_sentences.en: The movie was a bit boring at first, but it got better.
At first, we thought it was a joke.
I couldn't understand him at first because he spoke too fast.
my_sentences.ko: (걔가 말이 너무 빨라서 처음에는 알아들을 수가 없었어.)

my_sentences.en: It was scary at first, but now I enjoy riding roller coasters.
my_sentences.ko: (처음에는 무서웠는데, 지금은 롤러코스터 타는 걸 즐겨.)

my_sentences.en: in the first place / to begin with
my_sentences.ko: (애초에) → 주로 부정적인 상황에서 근본적인 원인을 따지거나, 후회할 때, 혹은 누군가를 탓할 때 자주 쓰입니다. "애당초 ~하지 말았어야지" 같은 문맥에 찰떡입니다.
bold_words: in the first place / to begin with

my_sentences.en: Why did you invite him in the first place?
We didn't have enough money to buy it to begin with.
my_sentences.ko: (애초에 우린 그걸 살 돈이 충분하지 않았어.)

my_sentences.en: I shouldn't have listened to you in the first place.
It wasn't my idea to begin with.
If you didn't like it, you shouldn't have bought it in the first place.
first
my_sentences.ko: (먼저)→ 순서상으로 '누가/무엇이 더 앞섰는지'를 나타냅니다. 행동의 선후 관계를 명확히 할 때 문장 끝이나 동사 뒤에 붙여 씁니다.

my_sentences.en: Who finished the exam first?
Let me wash my hands first.
She apologized first.
I saw it first, so it's mine!
They arrived at the restaurant first.
for the first time
my_sentences.ko: (처음으로)→ 살면서, 혹은 특정 기간 이후 '경험해 본 적 없는 일을 처음 겪었을 때' 그 특별함과 감회를 강조하는 표현입니다.

my_sentences.en: I traveled abroad for the first time last year.
He tried sushi for the first time and loved it.
We are meeting for the first time tomorrow.
I felt truly happy for the first time in a long time.
She performed in front of an audience for the first time.
It's my first time -ing / It's the first time S+V
my_sentences.ko: (~하는 게 처음이다) →  본문에 적어주신 것처럼 to 부정사를 쓰면 안 되고 동명사(-ing)나 완벽한 문장이 와야 자연스럽습니다. 경험을 나타내므로 현재완료(I have ever p.p)와도 자주 결합됩니다.

my_sentences.en: It's my first time trying this food.
Is it your first time visiting Korea?
It was the first time I had ever seen snow.
It's going to be the first time we travel together.
my_sentences.ko: (우리가 같이 여행 가는 건 이번이 처음이 될 거야.)

my_sentences.en: It was her first time speaking in public.

my_sentences.ko: (~에 익숙해지다)→단순히 '익숙하다(be used to)'가 아니라, '익숙해지는 과정이나 상태의 변화'를 나타낼 때 쓰입니다.

my_sentences.en: It takes time to get used to a new job.
I'm still getting used to waking up early.
my_sentences.ko: (나 아직 일찍 일어나는 거에 익숙해지는 중이야.)

my_sentences.en: Don't worry, you'll get used to it soon.
I can't get used to this cold weather.
She quickly got used to living alone.
shouldn't have p.p
my_sentences.ko: (~하지 말았어야 했다)→과거에 저지른 일에 대한 후회나 자책을 표현할 때 쓰는 마법의 패턴입니다. (반대로 'should have p.p'는 ~했어야 했다)

my_sentences.en: I shouldn't have eaten so much late at night.
You shouldn't have told him the secret.
I shouldn't have stayed up so late.
We shouldn't have trusted them in the first place.
He shouldn't have bought that expensive car.
my_sentences.ko: (걔는 그 비싼 차를 사지 말았어야 했어.)
